Very happy with the service. I was nervous as there was only one other review but I saw an ad on Instagram and decided to give them a try to touch up my lip filler. I only do 1cc and it had been over 7 months since I last touched it up in my home country. I was concerned because I am not a fan of the 'cherry lip' shape that is most popular here and most of the result photos on Insta were of clients who had requested that shape.

I met with the Dr and explained that I liked the shape of my lips and just wanted them fuller with a few adjustments. The Dr asked if I had any photos of the shapes that I like and I showed him. He suggested 2 different types of filler - restylane kysse and Flore. I chose the Flore because it is more cost efficient (I think around 7,000THB per cc). Once the Dr made the suggestions I then left with the sales associate who showed me the products and took me through pricing. I paid, sat with the numbing cream for about 40 minutes and then the Dr administered the filler. He was extremely nice and professional, took his time and told me that we could take a break whenever I wanted and also asked me if I was okay several times. The assistant was also so sweet and attentive. The clinic is well-managed, pretty and clean. Everybody smiles at you and they provide water while you wait.

4 days later and the swelling has gone down and I'm SUPER happy with the results. There is some swelling but the shape and feel is exactly what I wanted - soft and smooth with no bumps or hardness. I will go again for any other aesthetic needs and highly recommend.

Lastly, they did not offer any incentive for a review and nor did I request or expect one - they did not even mention a review. Adding this as another clinic I went to offered me a discount for a 5-star review and that made me concerned that the reviews I had seen were not honest.
